quote: A vehicle must not be driven to the left side of the highway at any time: When approaching within 100 feet or traversing any intersection or railroad grade crossing. Subsection 2 does not apply upon a one-way highway.

activation.condition: Vehicle is driven left of highway center while approaching or traversing an intersection or railroad grade crossing on a highway that is not one-way.

obligation.description: Do not drive to the left side of the highway in the stated zone.

exceptions.source_clause: Subsection 2 does not apply upon a one-way highway.
exceptions.description: The subsection is inapplicable on a one-way highway.

timing.description: At any time while within 100 feet of approach or while traversing either named feature.

parameter_refs.name: commanded_left_side_closest_distance_ft
parameter_refs.range_or_domain: nonnegative minimum feet across the left-side interval; must be checked against Native geometry

parameter_refs.name: observed_left_side_closest_distance_ft
parameter_refs.range_or_domain: Native minimum body distance in feet while left of center, initially unknown
